title: Uncertainty Monitoring and Cross-Task Cognitive Covariation in Honey Bees
summary: A falsifiable model-comparison project asking whether uncertainty-sensitive choice and cross-task learning covariation in honey bees are best explained by one general factor, separable but correlated factors, or task-local associative mechanisms. Earlier precision/self-awareness simulation claims have been retired from the canonical paper.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C full reconstruction replacing the legacy Paper 001 run
